510301.name: Large Caliber Rifle
510301.description: Fires large caliber rifles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. These rifles can be destroyed and will no longer fire once they are gone.

510302.name: Multi-Barrel Machine Gun
510302.description: Fires a barrage of machine gun bullets, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

510303.name: Mechanical Mine Missile
510303.description: Fires a volley of missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

510304.name: Highly Concentrated Particle Cannon
510304.description: Fires a highly concentrated particle cannon, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510305.name: Corrosive Tentacle
510305.description: Stabs a Nikke with its tentacles. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

510306.name: Explosive Tentacle
510306.description: Retracts its tentacle after dealing massive damage to the Nikke it stabbed.
